description: E1b scrambling reference under the Fig. 1 block convention (angle_scale 2): each block applies two RZZ gates, so the total ZZ angle is 2J, and J = pi/8 with b = pi/4 gives the dual-unitary (maximally scrambling) kicked-Ising point exp(-i pi/4 ZZ) exp(-i pi/4 X). It replaces the 'scrambling' setting of concentration.json (J = pi/4 gives a total ZZ angle of pi/2, i.e. Z x Z up to a phase, which is non-entangling). Same N, layers, seeds and inputs as concentration.json.
